study: ART 5, Swiss grade labels and the lexical demand of LLM-generated French reading texts
version: design-v0.4.7 (31.10.2026, PREREG.md fields filled from the pilot and the model listing of 31.10.2026: 16 topics, 7,680 texts, model ids; v0.4.6 of the same day checks each key secret before any request and removes key values from every output; v0.4.5 replaced Mistral Medium 3.5, deprecated by Mistral, by Mistral Large 4 as mistral_balanced; otherwise as v0.4.4 of 25.10.2026; after the pilot, before G1)
prompt_template: Écris {genre} pour des élèves{label}, sur le thème {topic}. Réponds seulement avec un titre et le texte.
n_topics_rule: smallest of 16, 24 or 32 topics with simulated power of at least .80 for a level difference of 0.04 Zipf (one year on the planning ruler of -0.04 Zipf per year), at the pilot's residual SD (upper 80% bound); set before G1 and confirmed at G1
topics: de la lune et des étoiles

L1.role: HarmoS H notation, bare (intercantonal documents, Fribourg)

L0.role: no audience level, baseline (one text per model, genre and topic)

L6.role: same digit with the French collège suffix, collision control (not at 6H, where de 6e is the L4 prompt of 8H)

probe_templates.P1: À quel âge correspondent des élèves de {grade} ?
probe_templates.P2: En Suisse romande, quel âge ont des élèves de {grade} ?

models.anthropic_balanced: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (exact dated id read at pilot)
models.anthropic_light: Claude Haiku 5.5 (exact dated id read at pilot)
models.openai_balanced: GPT-6.1 Sol (exact dated id read at pilot)
models.openai_light: GPT-6 Luna (exact dated id read at pilot)
models.mistral_balanced: Mistral Large 4 (exact dated id read at pilot; replaces Mistral Medium 3.5, deprecated on 31.10.2026)
models.mistral_light: Mistral Small 4 (exact dated id read at pilot)

sampling.fallback: if a model rejects temperature, it is omitted for that model and recorded

probe.note: parser check only; answers stored, accuracy not computed before the deposit

exclusion.refusal: finish reason content_filter or refusal, or one of the first two lines of the answer opening with a phrase of compute.REFUSAL_RE, directly or after a polite opener (compute.OPENER_RE); a first line of at most 12 words not ending with a period, an ellipsis, a question or exclamation mark or a colon is not tested when at least 20 words follow it
exclusion.flag_meta: kept, flagged and removed in a sensitivity analysis: an answer addressing the user in its first two or last three lines outside quotation marks and dialogue lines (compute.META_RE), or asking a question that names the grade label or the school system (compute.LABEL_Q_RE)

analysis.unit: topic-level level and gradient of paired differences (pairs matched on model, grade, genre and topic), two-sided one-sample t-tests over topics, Holm over the four tests, alpha .05
analysis.secondary: L3 against L5 and against L1, level and gradient
